payload.purpose: Prepare the likely correction/review decisions now from the confirmed static gaps, rather than reconstructing the same reasoning after each revision. The detailed source-pinned packet is in our verified private repository.
branches: Substitute owner still present -> reuse the accepted owner and its actual gate; verify both caller paths and transition serialization.
Uncertain outcomes disappear on restart -> reconstruct status-aware holds; repeat startup and reject further work until permitted reconciliation.
Quarantine permits clean startup -> retain durable damaged-state evidence; two subsequent startups must remain held with unchanged evidence.
New IDs or transfer bypass a hold -> move hold decisions/updates/recovery into the accepted gate; exercise paused competing operations.
Old grant spend or revocation is forgotten -> preserve constraints across restart; a new grant is distinct and cannot refund old spend or clear uncertainty.
Lifetime/journal failure still allows work -> enforce the agreed finite admission stops; use fake clocks/failures without claiming entered effects were rolled back.
Observed identity stops at a helper -> bind trusted connection context to the accepted caller path; reject fake mismatches without opening a pipe.
Malformed identifiers or noncanonical frames reach dispatch -> validate operation schemas and encoding first; invalid input must cause zero dispatch.
payload.decision_rule: For each next pinned revision, observe the trigger, check dependencies and invalidating evidence, then use the prepared test and acceptance oracle. Skip a branch already resolved; record reuse, mismatch or missing evidence. Missing accepted dependencies are blockers, not permission to build replacements.
payload.evidence_limit: These approaches and test specifications are unimplemented hypotheses. No tests or fixes were run, and no efficiency or prediction benefit is claimed. Existing source-only and live-activation limits remain.
payload.request: Use these finite branches with the current correction handoff. Return the corrected artifact and evidence when ready; no extra design round or acknowledgment-only reply is needed.
